en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: Dialect with verb forms like 'ми го паслo', 'му утепале'. 'Везден' (embroidered) is my reading, perhaps 'everywhere/all day'; 'сардисале' and 'посилеле' are guesses.

words_to_learn.en: marigold; here an epithet for a lad (my reading)

lines.cyr: Излегол невен Пејо по Шар Планина,
lines.lat: Izlegol neven Pejo po Šar Planina,
lines.en: Young Pejo went out onto Shar Mountain,

lines.cyr: да ми стадо паслo Пејо, на кавал ми свири.
lines.lat: da mi stado paslo Pejo, na kaval mi sviri.
lines.en: to graze the flock, Pejo, playing the shepherd's flute for me.

lines.cyr: Везден ми го паслo Пејо, ем до полноќум.
lines.lat: Vezden mi go paslo Pejo, em do polnoḱum.
lines.en: Embroidered, he grazed it, Pejo, even until midnight.

lines.cyr: Еј, од полноќум, џанам, стадо ми дотерал,
lines.lat: Ej, od polnoḱum, džanam, stado mi doteral,
lines.en: Hey, from midnight, dear, he drove the flock home for me,

lines.cyr: ми го затворил џанам во ново трло.
lines.lat: mi go zatvoril džanam vo novo trlo.
lines.en: he shut it, dear, in the new fold.

lines.cyr: Пејо ми улегол, џанам, в' нова колиба.
lines.lat: Pejo mi ulegol, džanam, v' nova koliba.
lines.en: Pejo went in, dear, into the new hut.

lines.cyr: Еј, Пејо седнало, џанам, малку да вечера,
lines.lat: Ej, Pejo sednalo, džanam, malku da večera,
lines.en: Hey, Pejo sat down, dear, to have a little supper,

lines.cyr: ми вечерало, џанам, кучиња му лајат.
lines.lat: mi večeralo, džanam, kučinja mu lajat.
lines.en: he was having supper, dear, the dogs bark at him.
Pejo ran out, dear, and gave chase.

lines.cyr: Еј, проклети биле, џанам, клети арамии,
lines.lat: Ej, prokleti bile, džanam, kleti aramii,
lines.en: Hey, cursed be they, dear, the wicked bandits,

lines.cyr: што ми посилеле они по Шар Планина,
lines.lat: što mi posilele oni po Šar Planina,
lines.en: who descended on them, over Shar Mountain,

lines.cyr: што му утепале они верни кучиња
lines.lat: što mu utepale oni verni kučinja

lines.cyr: и му сардисале они трло ем колиба.
lines.lat: i mu sardisale oni trlo em koliba.
lines.en: and wrecked his fold and hut.

lines.cyr: Му сардисале они трло ем колиба,
lines.lat: Mu sardisale oni trlo em koliba,
lines.en: They wrecked his fold and hut,

lines.cyr: ми го фанале они млад невен Пејо,
lines.lat: mi go fanale oni mlad neven Pejo,

lines.cyr: и му врзале они раце наопако,
lines.lat: i mu vrzale oni race naopako,
lines.en: and tied his hands behind his back,

lines.cyr: му потерале они белото му стадо,
lines.lat: mu poterale oni beloto mu stado,
lines.en: and drove off his white flock,

lines.cyr: стадо не ми оди џанам без невен Пејо.
lines.lat: stado ne mi odi džanam bez neven Pejo.
lines.en: the flock does not walk without young Pejo.
